final.core_ui_handling:
BASE: first10, picked by 2 of 3 judges, with every agreed graft applied and every must_fix and overlap fixed.

UNITS: every rect is in real screen px. The origin is the top-left of the window, including the Roblox top bar.
- PC: 1280x720, inset 58, desktop UIScale 0.8, so px = du x 0.8.
- Phone: 749x361, inset 58 (assumed), touch UIScale 0.75, so px = du x 0.75.
- Top blocks start at inset+8 on PC and inset+4 on phone.

BUILD: add one new pure ModuleScript, HudLayout.luau. Inputs: viewport, GetGuiInset, input mode, the live TouchGui JumpButton rect, and the PlayerList left-edge estimate. It returns every rect.
- HUD, EventHUD, VitalsUI, GrudgeGhost, UIKit toasts and Panels all read from it. Add it to the ClientMain list before any require. This keeps HUD.luau and Fx.luau under the 200-local limit.
- Pick the layout from LastInputType plus the viewport, not from TouchEnabled, so a touchscreen laptop gets the PC layout.
- Live chain: meter bottom, then +4 chips (PC max 2 rows; phone row A, plus row B only for a second danger chip), then +4 notify area, down to a hard cap: PC y258 (top+240du), phone y165.
- Delete UIKit TOAST_Y=152, HUD L.StripBelow=47, the CR-L36 luck clamp and EventHUD KING.place. The uncommitted Pumpkin King edit must be moved into the chip/sticky system before it is committed.
- Notify area: one sticky slot first. Priority: danger warning > AFK > travel > personal line (sack, kaiju form, revenge) > live event (goose tug, live king, live kaiju, siren) > announce ribbon or zone banner. Lower live events fall back to chips. Then toasts (24 px on PC, 18 px on phone, gaps 4/3) only while they fit above the cap. The rest wait in a queue, and repeated loot merges ('+슬라임 젤리 x3').

NARROW PC (logical width < 1500du, e.g. 1024x768 or 1280x1024):
- The rail moves under the plate, and the quest panel moves down by rail height + 8.
- The top column centres between plate right+8 and PlayerList left-8, with the meter at least 240du. At 1024x768 that is about x291-540.
- The PlayerList-left formula keeps the column out from under the list.

TOP BAR: nothing of ours goes in y < inset on either device. No TopbarSafeInsets exception is used.

PLAYERLIST (PC, CoreGui, open by default):
- Reserved x800-1276, y62-470 (estimate). Nothing persistent goes there.
- Top column width = min(360du, 2*(PLleft-16-W/2)), which gives x496-784 at 1280x720.
- Z (top y510) and 자동 (top y520) stay 40+ px below the estimated list bottom.
- While any modal is open (Panels window, confirm, WorldMap, KO card), call StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(PlayerList,false), then restore the player's own state on close. If the restore misbehaves, fall back to a PC window at x428-784.
- leaderstats order: 전투력 (an IntValue fed by CombatPower, created first so the list sorts by it), 레벨, 환생, 명성. Remove 골드 (A23-21, BB12).
- Phone: the list lives in the Roblox menu, so no zone is reserved.

CHAT:
- First read TextChatService.ChatVersion in the live place. The place file says Legacy (token 0); HUD.Start assumes TextChatService.
- PC: ChatWindowConfiguration Left/Bottom, with WidthScale/HeightScale tuned until window plus input bar is about x8-420, y448-712. Legacy fallback: SetCore ChatWindowPosition/Size to the same box. That corner has no thumbstick on PC. The quest panel ends at y409 even when expanded, and windows start at x428, so the chat no longer swallows 받기.
- Phone: closed by default. When opened, Roblox puts it top-left over the plate, which is accepted (visual_direction:209).

PHONE CONTROLS:
- The thumbstick zone is Roblox's real DynamicThumbstick area: x < 0.4W, y > H/3 (x0-300, y120-361). Fix HUD L.StickZoneX and EventHUD ThumbW/ThumbH/outOfThumbZone to match.
- Nothing interactive sits there. Only the passive top-column lines at x241-300, y120-165 touch it, and they are Active=false.
- The cluster anchors to the live JumpButton: attack 8 px left of jump, 자동 8 px above jump, Q at about 175° and Z at about 125° around attack, ghost at about 72° above attack, potions left of Q at x >= 337.
- Backpack and Health CoreGui stay disabled. Emotes, Tab and shift lock stay reserved.

WINDOWS (A23-20: auto keeps fighting while a window is open):
- PC: window x428-1048, y120-570 (775x562du), between the chat and the cluster and below the rail. The full-screen dim stays at Z50. The plate, potions, Q, Z, attack, 자동 and ghost are reparented out of the HUD root (Z5, Sibling) into MainGui at Z55+, so they stay visible and clickable. VitalsUI.canUse stops refusing potions while a window is open (VitalsUI.luau:24). While a window is open, toasts move under it (x496-784, y578-662).
- Phone: window x8-448, y62-353. The dim covers only x0-452 (Active), so attack, Q, Z, 자동, ghost, jump, rail and quest row keep working. The window header carries HP/MP mini bars and two 45 px potion buttons. Walking pauses while a window is open. Toasts queue until it closes, except the danger warning, which shows in the header.

WORLD LABELS:
- Gate signs become a SurfaceGui on the lintel (a server MapBuilder change plus a map rebuild). Interim fix: MaxDistance 60.
- Each frame the client hides any world billboard that projects into the top column, rail, plate, quest panel or PlayerList zone: the '여기로!' label, monster bars and gate signs. An edge arrow takes over for the guide label.
- Monster bars shrink to 120x28, MaxDistance about 70, with the name only for monsters fighting me or within 30 studs.

NUMERIC CHECK (scratchpad check_final.py), run at 1280x720, 749x361 and an anchor-derived 844x390. Result: 0 problems.
- Every rect is inside the screen.
- No two always-visible or event interactive rects overlap. Circles are measured as circles.
- Tightest PC gaps: rail buttons 4, header to rows 4, HP to MP potion 6, attack to Q 6.5, attack to Z 6.9, ghost to MP potion 8, Z to PlayerList bottom 40, rail to top column 6, column to PlayerList 16.
- Tightest phone gaps: HP to MP potion 4, rail and quest row 6, Q to window edge 7, attack to Q 7.4, attack to Z 7.0, attack to ghost 6.6, Q to MP potion 7.2, 자동 to jump 8, Z to overlay bottom 6, column bottom 165 to Z top 180.
- Nothing interactive overlaps the top bar, the PlayerList, the chat, the thumbstick zone or the jump button.
- Transients cover only what is listed:
  - PC window: the PlayerList, which is hidden while the window is open.
  - Phone window: plate and potions, both duplicated in its header; the thumbstick zone, as a modal.
  - Phone quest overlay: rail and quest row, briefly, until it closes.
  - Phone confirm and KO card: they sit in the thumbstick zone, as a modal and a dead-state card.

risks: The PlayerList size is an estimate (x800-1276, y62-470). Measure it with screen_capture at 1280x720 with 3, 8 and 20 players. If its bottom passes about y505, Z and 자동 lose mouse clicks (keys still work). Then drop Z and 자동 into one bottom row (HP, MP, Z, Q, F, with 자동 left of it).

SetCoreGuiEnabled(PlayerList,false) while a modal is open may not restore the player's own Tab open or closed state. Test in Play. If it fails, use the fallback PC window x428-784 (445du wide) and check that the BB7 bag still fits.
The PC window shrinks from 780x600du to 775x562du, and the phone window is 440x291 px (587x388du). Check the BB7 bag grid (88du cells) and the BB13 menu at those sizes.

The phone top-bar inset (58) and the phone JumpButton rect are assumptions. Measure GetGuiInset and TouchGui.JumpButton live at 749x361 and 844x390. The anchor-derived 844x390 check passes only if the jump button sits at (W-95, H-90).

Chat version: the committed place is LegacyChatService (token 0), while HUD.Start assumes TextChatService. Read ChatVersion live, then reach about x8-420, y448-712 with the API that is actually running. The size comes from tuned scales, not an exact rect.
The PC rail beside the plate departs from visual_direction ('오른쪽 위: [가방][지도][메뉴]'). It is forced by the default-open PlayerList. The user must OK it in the ART-G0 grey box before ART-G1.
Removing the 대장간 card puts the path '150G → 나무 무기 (optional)' on the tutorial guide step and the quest rows. Check that in a timed 10-minute fresh-account Play.

Phone text is 16du = 12 real px in 12-18 px rows. Measure TextBounds via MCP for the luck chip ('희귀 10.75%'), slot-3 chips, the quest row and the war info line, and use the short TXT fallbacks. English strings (BB29) are about 30% longer.
The phone luck chip shortens the A23-18 text to a clover icon + '희귀 10.75%' when the full sentence does not fit. Ask the user once whether that is acceptable. PC keeps the full sentence on the plate.

On phone, a window or confirm puts its dim over the thumbstick, so walking pauses while a window is open. Attack, skills, 자동, jump and the header potions still work. Check in a phone Play that this feels fine.
The phone quest overlay uses 38 px rows (about 50du), below the 60du touch guideline. If taps miss, make it a 1-column list that scrolls, keeping the bottom at y174.
Roblox system notifications (badges, friend requests) appear at the bottom-right on PC over attack, Q and the potions for a few seconds. They cannot be moved.
Lifting the plate, potions and cluster above the dim, and making the phone dim left-side only, need a Panels modal-root refactor. Every BB7/BB8/BB9/BB11/BB13 window depends on it, so do it first.
HUD.luau (about 147 top-level locals) and Fx.luau (about 168) are near the 200-local limit. All rects and new state go into HudLayout.luau and tables (L, ui, TXT).

Gate sign to SurfaceGui is a server MapBuilder change and a map rebuild, and it changes how readable the signs are from far away. If time is short, ship the interim (MaxDistance 60 + culling) together with the zone chip and banner.

The 1582x950 capture shows about 1.15 px per du with blocks starting at y133. That matches neither the code's UIScale cap nor the 58 px inset. Measure AbsolutePosition, UIScale and GetGuiInset at 1280x720, 1024x768, 749x361 and 844x390 before pixel sign-off.

Budget: ART-G1 is planned at 2 days, and this layout is about 4-5 dev days. Order: HudLayout + live BottomY chain + PlayerList clamp/hide + dim refactor + thumb-zone constants first. Then quest rows/forge, chips/sticky, and the combat cluster move. World billboards, gate signs and the narrow-PC rule last.

The bully/outlaw chip is short, so the 자동 lock (L.RefreshAuto reading BullyStacks and the outlaw flag) and the reason toast must land in the same commit. Otherwise a child cannot tell why auto stopped.

roblox_core_constraints: Top bar inset (general-knowledge + verified-in-code): Roblox's current top bar is about 58 px tall on PC; GetGuiInset().Y was 36 before the 2023 redesign. Phone value unverified, measure via MCP. MainGui uses IgnoreGuiInset=true, ScreenInsets=DeviceSafeInsets and SafeAreaCompatibility=None (verified UIKit.luau:1744-1757). HUD, EventHUD and toasts place every top block at GetGuiInset().Y + 8 real px, with a 64 px fallback when the inset reads 0 (verified HUD.luau:308-316 and 3313-3315, UIKit.luau:231-239, EventHUD.luau:249-257, Config.luau:2152-2154).

UIScale (verified UIKit.luau:247-256, Config.luau:2155-2160): touch scale is clamp(viewportY/720, 0.75, 1.25); desktop is clamp(viewportY/720 x 0.8, 0.6, 1.0). Resulting logical canvases: 1280x720 PC = 0.8 (1600x900); 749x361 phone = 0.75 (999x481); 1280x720 touch = 1.0. IS_TOUCH = UserInputService.TouchEnabled, so a touchscreen laptop gets the touch layout (verified HUD.luau:47).

Top-left of the top bar (general-knowledge): the Roblox menu button and the unibar (chat toggle, '...' menu with leaderboard, emotes, etc.) sit at the top-left, inside the inset band. The HUD keeps x=12 below the band.

Chat on PC (general-knowledge): TextChatService's window opens top-left under the top bar and is visible by default on PC. On phones it is closed by default (visual_direction:209 agrees). It is CoreGui, so it draws above every PlayerGui ScreenGui and takes clicks (verified symptom: HUD.luau:3554-3555 says it swallowed the quest [받기] click).

ChatWindowConfiguration (general-knowledge + verified-in-code): HorizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment, WidthScale and HeightScale can be set in Studio and from a LocalScript at runtime, but only under TextChatService. HUD.Start already sets Center/Bottom and scales <= 0.7 on desktop (verified HUD.luau:3556-3566). Under LegacyChatService only SetCore('ChatWindowPosition'/'ChatWindowSize') moves it; the code sets (0,0,0.6,0) (verified HUD.luau:352-366).

Chat version conflict (verified-in-code, needs runtime check): the committed place has TextChatService.ChatVersion token 0 (LegacyChatService) and IsLegacyChatDisabled=false. Its ChatWindowConfiguration is HorizontalAlignment=Left(1), VerticalAlignment=Bottom(2), WidthScale 0.85, HeightScale 0.8 (verified place/GoodEvil.rbxlx:128411-128466). Announce.luau:113-127 says legacy still runs, but the 2026-10-06 HUD comment describes TextChatService behaviour. Roblox has been migrating experiences off LegacyChatService (general-knowledge). Read TextChatService.ChatVersion in the live place before designing around either.

PlayerList (general-knowledge): CoreGui at the top-right just under the top bar. Open by default on PC and toggled with Tab (Tab is Reserved in Config.Keybinds, verified Config.luau:1752). Shows at most 4 leaderstats columns, sorts by the first column, and groups players under Team headers with team totals. Width is roughly 165-170 px for names plus about 70-75 px per stat, so about 450-480 px with 4 stats (estimate, measure in Studio). At 1280x720 it covers about x800-1276 from y≈62 down: the luck panel, 대장간 card and 자동/지도/메뉴 squares (real x1102-1270, y66-231). On phones it is hidden behind the Roblox menu.

leaderstats setup (verified PlayerService.luau:271-315): IntValues created in the order 레벨, 골드 (BankGold+CarriedGold), 환생, 명성 (Honor for Halo, Infamy for Horns, else 0), refreshed on LEADERSTAT_KEYS.
